messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Mining, Metals, ESG and Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Hoffmann Reed Saudi Arabia Team,

Your Riyadh expansion and stated focus on board, executive committee and senior leadership appointments across mining and metals make this a focused introduction. I also noted Hoffmann Reed's Saudi coverage across the supporting infrastructure around mining, including power, water, logistics and transport.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My current work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, social performance, institutional partnerships and cross-functional operating matters with executive-level visibility. Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, metals, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming Saudi leadership searches where institutional engagement, responsible mining, sustainability and country-facing execution sit at the center of the mandate. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
